notes: POC scope: nightly batch embed of ~100k product docs, realtime semantic search for product help (peak concurrent queries ~400 qps), reranking on top-K results.

Initial throughput targets: embed throughput >= 6k docs/hour for nightly job using hosted model (would prefer 10k+ in Dedicated). Query latency target: median <60ms, p95 <200ms for 5-10k top-K retrievals.

Vector DB test matrix: Pinecone (managed), Qdrant (managed), Milvus (self-hosted on GCP). Currently Milvus showing best write throughput in our infra tests but search latency variability with larger shards.

Integration notes: backend currently pushes embedding batches via Airflow to containerized worker; wants a straightforward SDK + batching API. Asked about direct server-side batching support and prefix/KV caching to reduce repeated context costs.
Security: must have SSO + SCIM mapping for roles, KMS support for key rotation, SOC2 attestation required before procurement. Also wants per-route auditing and retention options (90/365 days choice).

Pricing: prefer committing to Dedicated with monthly reserved capacity if committed ARR > $75k. AE provided a 3-tier quote (small/medium/large GPU pools) — customer asked for usage breakpoints and auto-burst policies.
Quote request: customer asks 'show cost @ 100k embeds/day + 300k queries/month' comparing hosted vs Dedicated (pool of 2xA10 / 8xA100 options).

Technical blocker: embedding drift across model variants — product team saw semantic recall drop 6% when switching to quantized variant; needs regression evals tied to prompt sets (check Redwood Optimize eval hooks).
Customer quote from CTO: 'If you can guarantee steady p95 <250ms with a reliable failover to cheaper model variants, we can justify Dedicated.'
